position_sizing.conditional_logic: Grid EAs incrementally increase lot size at each grid level, typically using a multiplier (martingale-style)

custom_logic_notes: Grid Master EA places pending buy stop/sell stop or buy limit/sell limit orders at fixed intervals (grid levels) from a base price. Each level may increase lot size by a multiplier (martingale). Total profit is monitored and all positions closed when a profit target is reached. Margin check is critical to avoid margin calls during drawdown. Exact parameters (grid step, lot multiplier, max levels, profit target) cannot be extracted due to binary file read failure.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategies are classified as mt5_only due to heavy pending order management, martingale-style sizing that depends on margin, and tick-level grid level monitoring. A Python conversion would require: (1) full pending order book simulation, (2) margin calculation engine, (3) multi-position P&L tracking, (4) order fill simulation at exact grid levels. Recommend keeping in MT5 for accurate backtesting.
